224-1772-3478-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1409-1818-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

141-653-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-6797.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

1011-2728-5662-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5662-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5662-6798.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.

3532-3949-5078-7693.description:

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.

147-6797-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.

Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and exiling Ephemerate.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.

Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1494-3209-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-3209-4613-7152.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{U}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-3209-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Sprout Swarm. Sprout Swarm is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion. You can use Sprout Swarm's convoke cost to reduce the mana you need to pay.

Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

Holding priority, activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.

Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or greater.

If the sacrificed creature had mana value 3 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

Resolve Debt to the Deathless, causing each opponent to lose twice X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
